title: Solar Particle Event (SPE) Precursor & Biological Radioprotection Protocol
plain_language_summary: Dosimetry rate exceeds nominal background or DNA repair marker trajectory shows elevated cumulative oxidative load.
crew_instructions: Verify personal dosimeter placement and cross-check with module radiation sensor telemetry.
Prepare crew sleep quarters storm shelter shielding (water wall / polyethylene stowage configuration).
Administer pre-approved antioxidant nutritional supplementation pack as per flight surgeon protocol.
Queue peripheral blood sample for DNA damage (gamma-H2AX / 53BP1 kinetics) analysis at next scheduled pass.
de_escalation_criteria: External dosimeter rate returns to nominal galactic cosmic ray (GCR) background level for > 6 hours.
